supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-ledger authentication failures occurred on FILE-SUN-01 from 13:33:44 through 13:48:34 UTC. The failures recur at roughly one-minute intervals, identify FILE-SUN-01 as the workstation, and report bad-password status 0xc000006a.

Domain-controller records also show bad-password validation failures for svc-ledger from FILE-SUN-01, including Kerberos pre-authentication failures with status 0x18 and NTLM validation failures with status 0xc000006a.

The regular cadence and FILE-SUN-01 source are consistent with the inventory's every-minute LedgerSync reauthentication on FILE-SUN-01; the scheduled 13:30 UTC password rotation could explain repeated failures if the job had not yet been updated. This is a plausible explanation, not proof of the cause.

At 13:34:53 UTC, a separate explicit-credentials event on WS-ZADAMS-01 records SYSTEM running PowerShell with target account svc-ledger and target server PROXY-SUN-01. This use is unexplained by the supplied inventory context and warrants investigation, but the record does not establish that authentication succeeded or that it caused the FILE-SUN-01 failures.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records cover only activity shown from 13:33:44 to 13:48:34 UTC; they do not establish what occurred during the rest of the requested 13:20–14:20 window.
The records do not show whether the explicit-credentials attempt from WS-ZADAMS-01 succeeded, what PowerShell command or script ran, or whether it is related to the repeated failures.
The evidence contains no supplied successful logon records or application-level LedgerSync/job-update telemetry that would confirm the rotation explanation.
claims_not_established: That an attacker caused the repeated bad-password failures.
That the svc-ledger credentials were used successfully from WS-ZADAMS-01 or against PROXY-SUN-01.
That the FILE-SUN-01 failures were definitely caused by LedgerSync retaining the pre-rotation password.
That the explicit-credentials event on WS-ZADAMS-01 is connected to the alerted failures.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-SUN-01 authentication and proxy access logs around 13:34:53 UTC to determine whether the svc-ledger attempt succeeded and what it accessed.
WS-ZADAMS-01 process and PowerShell telemetry for PID 0x1554, including command line, script contents, parent process, and user/session context.
FILE-SUN-01 LedgerSync service/job logs and configuration history showing the password rotation and the time the job was updated.
Authentication records for svc-ledger across the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window, including any successful logons.
